meta.name: evaluate
meta.description: Evaluate an AI workflow against representative cases and its permitted actions. Use for model, retrieval or agent evaluation; tests do not grant release authority.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代表性案例检验 AI 工作流,提前看清模型、检索与智能体到底靠不靠谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿不准 AI 模型或智能体上线后的实际效果
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're unsure how well your AI model or agent actually performs

howto.what: Claude 会先读任务上下文契约与评估方法,再按代表性案例和允许的动作范围评估 AI 工作流,产出评估结论;评估本身不授予发布权限。
howto.when: 当你要评估模型、检索或 agent 时接管;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前脱敏 packet 与范围,不重跑已完成的设置和问答。

say.text: 用代表性案例评估这个 AI 工作流
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约和评估方法

say.text: 评估这个检索流程,说明哪些检查没跑
say.note: 缺失能力会如实报告,不假装已测

say.text: 在允许的动作范围内评估这个 agent
say.note: 未知项会保留,不擅自填补

howto.what_en: Claude reads the task context contract and eval method, then evaluates an AI workflow against representative cases and its permitted actions. Tests do not grant release authority.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need model, retrieval or agent evaluation; if called by @fde it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Evaluate this AI workflow against representative cases
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first

say_en.text: Evaluate this retrieval flow and report unrun checks
Evaluate this agent within its permitted actions
say_en.note: Unknowns are preserved, not filled in
